props.name: onDownload
props.description: Does the download. Resolve when the file is saved; reject to show the error state.

props.name: size
props.description: File size in bytes, shown in the label so the reader knows what they are starting.

props.name: format
props.description: File type shown beside the size — "PDF".

props.name: resetAfter
props.description: How long "Downloaded" stays before the button resets, in ms. 0 keeps it.
